tasks.label: 📊 Coverage Report
tasks.command: cd backend; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest --cov=app --cov-report=html tests/unit; start htmlcov/index.html

tasks.label: 🔒 Security Scan (Bandit)
tasks.command: cd backend; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m bandit -r app -f json -o ../security_report.json; type ../security_report.json

tasks.label: 🗄️ Check Slow Queries (PostgreSQL)
tasks.command: psql -U postgres -d Savora -c "SELECT query, mean_exec_time, calls FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY mean_exec_time DESC LIMIT 10;"
